text:
Maya: Friday LAN + indie show-and-tell in the lounge? projector + optional stream. Projector bulb was a bit dim last time, so if anyone has an HDMI switch or capture card please bring it. Also planning a small snack table — pls note allergies. RSVP by Thurs. :popcorn:

Tom: I can bring a 4-port HDMI switch and a surge strip. What time are we thinking?

Alan: I can bring my Elgato HD60 S (capture card) and a spare USB-C power bank for docked Switches.

Sanjay: Count me in. Bringing my Steam Deck. FYI office ethernet is choked to 6 ports — someone grabbed the spare switch last time. @Tom can we daisy-chain?

Judy: I'm on snack duty — I'll bring gluten-free cookies and hummus. Any nut allergies? Also can someone share the room code?

Maya: sweet — please avoid nuts (we have a nut allergy). Room code is 4512. Let's start around 6pm and run to ~11pm. If people want to demo, 10-min slots.

ops-bot: Reminder: please unplug any personal gear from the shared surge strip at the end of the event. If you need overnight storage for AV gear, file a ticket with #eng-infra.

Tom: 6pm works for me. I'll also bring an extra unmanaged ethernet switch. Anyone need HDMI cables?

Alan: I have 2x HDMI 2.0 cables, I can bring them.

Sanjay: I can also bring a portable router + ethernet cable, in case we need more ports or a local network for demos. I can set a static IP if needed.

Judy: I'll make a labeled gluten-free snack box and bring extra napkins. Also bringing two extra controllers.

Maya: Thanks team. Quick callout: react with :thumbsup: if you're demoing, :raised_hand: if you're just playing, and :yum: if you want snacks. I'll compile sign-ups tomorrow.

Tom: :thumbsup: (bringing capture + switch + cables)

Alan: :thumbsup: (speedrun practice/demo)

Sanjay: :raised_hand: (playing co-op)

Judy: :yum: (snacks crew)

Maya: Awesome. One more thing — anyone object to running the projector on lower brightness to save the bulb life? :lamp:

Alan: fine with low brightness. Also can someone bring gaffer tape for cables?

Tom: I'll bring gaffer tape.

Maya: Perfect. I'll post a final list and slot order tomorrow. See you Friday! :video_game:
